units: <cite ref="Berakhot 33a:22">Ber. 33ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 94:1">Ps. XCIV, 1</cite>) <he>גדולה נ׳ וכ׳</he> divine judgment is something great, for it is placed between two divine names.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> <he>עד שאנקום קְמָתָן וכ׳</he>. until I execute judgment for the slaughter of the Ephraimites.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 149:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXLIX, 7</cite> <he>איזו היא נ׳ … מה שנקמו לישראל</he> what revenge is meant here?… the revenge for the evil they did to Israel.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 149:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא נִקְמַת אדם</he> nor will it be a revenge executed by man; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְקָמוֹת</he>.
Ib. כל הנ׳ האילו יש וכ׳ all these retaliations are reserved with the Lord for the wicked; a. e.—[Ber. l. c. שתי נ הללו וכ׳ why these two judgments (n’ḳamah in the plural)?; v., however, הוֹפָעָה.]
